use std::hash::{Hash, Hasher};
use std::sync::atomic::{AtomicUsize, Ordering};
use tracing::{Event, Metadata, Subscriber, span};
static SPANS: AtomicUsize = AtomicUsize::new(0);
static EVENTS: AtomicUsize = AtomicUsize::new(0);
static HASH_WORDS: AtomicUsize = AtomicUsize::new(0);
static ENTERS: AtomicUsize = AtomicUsize::new(0);
static EXITS: AtomicUsize = AtomicUsize::new(0);
struct Words(usize);
impl Hasher for Words {
    fn finish(&self) -> u64 { 0 }
    fn write(&mut self, _: &[u8]) { panic!("unexpected pointer hash byte write") }
    fn write_usize(&mut self, _: usize) { self.0 += 1; }
}
struct Counter;
impl Subscriber for Counter {
    fn enabled(&self, _: &Metadata<'_>) -> bool { true }
    fn new_span(&self, attrs: &span::Attributes<'_>) -> span::Id {
        let mut words = Words(0);
        attrs.metadata().callsite().hash(&mut words);
        assert_eq!(words.0, 2);
        HASH_WORDS.fetch_add(words.0, Ordering::SeqCst);
        SPANS.fetch_add(1, Ordering::SeqCst);
        span::Id::from_u64(1)
    }
    fn record(&self, _: &span::Id, _: &span::Record<'_>) {}
    fn record_follows_from(&self, _: &span::Id, _: &span::Id) {}
    fn event(&self, _: &Event<'_>) { EVENTS.fetch_add(1, Ordering::SeqCst); }
    fn enter(&self, _: &span::Id) { ENTERS.fetch_add(1, Ordering::SeqCst); }
    fn exit(&self, _: &span::Id) { EXITS.fetch_add(1, Ordering::SeqCst); }
}
fn main() {
    tracing::subscriber::with_default(Counter, || {
        let scope = tracing::info_span!("scope", answer = 42u64);
        let _entered = scope.enter();
        tracing::info!(value = 7u64, "first event");
        tracing::info!("second event");
    });
    assert_eq!(SPANS.load(Ordering::SeqCst), 1);
    assert_eq!(EVENTS.load(Ordering::SeqCst), 2);
    assert_eq!(HASH_WORDS.load(Ordering::SeqCst), 2);
    assert_eq!(ENTERS.load(Ordering::SeqCst), 1);
    assert_eq!(EXITS.load(Ordering::SeqCst), 1);
    println!("{} {} {}", SPANS.load(Ordering::SeqCst), EVENTS.load(Ordering::SeqCst), HASH_WORDS.load(Ordering::SeqCst));
}
